Record Class Board

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.board.Board
Record Components:
offerTiles - ordered list of offer tiles, left to right
turnOrderTile - the turn order tile for the next round
public record Board(List<OfferTile> offerTiles, TurnOrderTile turnOrderTile) extends Record
Central game board. Aggregates the list of OfferTile (the action offers players choose during the placing phase) and the TurnOrderTile that drives the next round's turn order. Also provides lookup helpers and the conversion to a serializable BoardState.
